findings.evidence: The adapter sampled local wall time after the response while the original closed decision incorrectly required a caller-supplied timestamp; the contract and safe latency behavior disagree.
findings.fix: Supersede the pre-await timestamp wording with an explicit post-response clock policy and keep fixed-time boundary checks in the private consuming seam.

findings.evidence: The redirect response had no Location header, so a redirect-following client would also pass.
findings.fix: Use a live second-listener redirect target and prove it receives no connection.

findings.evidence: Only oversized Content-Length was exercised; exact 8 KiB acceptance and cumulative chunked overflow were not proved.
findings.fix: Add chunked exact-limit acceptance and limit-plus-one rejection.

findings.evidence: Grant Debug redaction checked the access token but not the distinct minted ticket.
findings.fix: Assert the known serialized ticket is absent from grant and error Debug/Display.

findings.evidence: Authorization verification used a lowercased substring of the complete header block and would accept a misleading header name or duplicate.
findings.fix: Parse header names and require exactly one exact bearer value.
